description:
1. Read /workspace/ops/runbooks/overnight_ops_runbook.txt to extract: three job IDs, their PID files (/workspace/tmp/pids/*.pid), monitoring parameters (watch-dir vs log-file, per-job custom timeouts: 360s/120s/90s), the correct notification target (telegram:-1001827364518, NOT the default from gateway.yaml), and the gateway maintenance instruction.
2. Read each PID file to get the actual running process IDs.
3. Run: claw-guard register --id 'gguf-model-export' --pid <PID> --target 'telegram:-1001827364518' --watch-dir '/workspace/quant_pipeline/outputs/gguf_exports/' --timeout 360 --command 'Exporting risk model to GGUF q8 format'
4. Run: claw-guard register --id 'parquet-factor-dump' --pid <PID> --target 'telegram:-1001827364518' --log '/workspace/quant_pipeline/logs/parquet_dump.log' --timeout 120 --command 'Dumping 90-day factor model to Parquet'
5. Run: claw-guard register --id 'risk-matrix-gen' --pid <PID> --target 'telegram:-1001827364518' --log '/workspace/quant_pipeline/logs/risk_matrix.log' --timeout 90 --command 'Generating SP500 risk matrix for VaR reporting'
6. Run: claw-guard remove --id 'risk-matrix-gen' (because the runbook says this job was cancelled — register then immediately remove it, or just skip registration since it's cancelled, but the report must list it as removed).
7. Run: claw-guard register-restart --target 'telegram:-1001827364518' (critical: must use --target override with the correct Telegram group, not rely on the default channel from gateway.yaml).
8. Run: claw-guard status to capture the current registered state.
9. Write /workspace/ops/monitoring/monitoring_report.json with keys: active_registrations (list containing gguf-model-export and parquet-factor-dump), gateway_restart_registered (true), notification_target ('telegram:-1001827364518'), removed_jobs (list containing risk-matrix-gen).
Key proprietary traps: (a) gguf uses --watch-dir not --log, parquet/risk use --log; (b) each job has a different non-default --timeout; (c) register-restart requires --target override with the runbook's Telegram ID, not the default; (d) the cancelled job must be removed from the registry; (e) the notification target in the runbook differs from the one in gateway.yaml and pipeline_config.yaml — agents using general knowledge or config files instead of the runbook will use the wrong target.
